summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee today chaired a meeting at the Chief Executive's Office to hear progress reports on systemic reforms following the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po, directing bureaus and departments to press ahead with the reforms and submit amendment bills for six laws to the Legislative Council as soon as possible. He also instructed the steering committee chaired by the Chief Secretary to co-ordinate the reforms and ensure they are implemented in full, and told the cross-departmental task force to step up its crackdown on bid-rigging and to set up a new building maintenance support and services authority. Lee reiterated the government's firm determination to reform the building maintenance system, saying every recommendation must be followed through carefully so that a similar tragedy never happens again, while support for affected residents will continue so they can rebuild their lives as soon as possible.

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has again voiced support for former Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang returning to the job, saying he hopes Nvidia's board will rehire him as it would be the best outcome for the company and for the United States. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told a CBS programme that Washington is seeking answers on Nvidia's chip sales to China and will establish who was responsible for the company's compliance matters during Huang's tenure. summary.en: Hong Kong stocks narrowed their losses by the close, with the Hang Seng Index falling 27 points, or 0.12 per cent, to 22,383 on main-board turnover of nearly HK$253.1 billion. The index had dropped more than 410 points in early trading, breaching the 22,000 level to an intraday low of 21,998, before turning up nearly 30 points in the afternoon. The Hang Seng Tech Index fell three points to 3,508 after dropping more than 3 per cent and losing the 3,400 level early in the session. Car stocks were under pressure, with Nio, Li Auto and XPeng down nearly 4 to more than 6 per cent and Leapmotor plunging nearly 13 per cent, the worst performer among tech index constituents; AI-related shares rose, with Lenovo up nearly 8 per cent, the best performer in both indexes. summary.en: The Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry, Professor Sun Dong, will depart for Nanjing and Hefei this evening, leading a Hong Kong delegation to attend the 20th meeting of the Mainland/Hong Kong Science and Technology Co-operation Committee in Hefei on November 25. summary.en: HK Electric said it will set aside HK$78 million next year to roll out an enhanced Smart Power Service, helping disadvantaged groups ease energy costs, assisting buildings in improving energy efficiency and promoting the electrification of transport. On community care, the company will provide electricity subsidies of HK$1,000 per household to eligible subdivided-flat tenants, and distribute cash coupons worth HK$200 each to 10,000 disadvantaged families. summary.en: An incoming male passenger was sentenced to seven months' imprisonment and fined HK$1,000 at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts today for importing duty-not-paid cigarettes and failing to declare them to Customs officers, in contravention of the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance. Customs officers intercepted a 56-year-old mainland male passenger arriving in Hong Kong from Hangzhou at Hong Kong International Airport on October 28 and seized about 61,200 duty-not-paid cigarettes from his personal baggage, with an estimated market value of about HK$306,000 and a duty potential of about HK$202,300. Customs welcomed the sentence, saying the custodial term has a considerable deterrent effect and reflects the seriousness of the offences. Under the ordinance, cigarettes are dutiable goods; anyone dealing in, possessing, selling or buying illicit cigarettes commits an offence punishable by a maximum fine of HK$2 million and seven years' imprisonment.

summary.en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warned in an interview on Sunday that the Federal Reserve could make a policy mistake and endanger the US economy if it tightens monetary policy too aggressively in response to the latest inflation data. He said the financial system was already showing signs of fragility, financial conditions had tightened noticeably in recent months, and a series of hawkish remarks by Fed officials was worrying. summary.en: The European-Japanese BepiColombo spacecraft slipped into orbit around Mercury on Saturday, ending an eight-year, 10-billion-kilometre journey and becoming only the second mission ever to orbit the Solar System's innermost planet. summary.en: The High Court murder trial over the 2023 killing of Hong Kong socialite Abby Choi Tin-fung has entered its 42nd day, with Justice Patrick Keane expected to conclude the evidential phase as early as Tuesday and an eight-member jury likely to retire to consider verdicts in the first week of December. Three defendants — former husband Alex Kwong Kong-chi, former brother-in-law Anthony Kwong Kong-kit and former father-in-law Kwong Kau — deny murdering Choi on 21 February 2023, though all three have pleaded guilty to preventing the lawful burial of her body. Testimony has reconstructed a 21-year entanglement linking the Choi, Kwong and Tam families, including the leasing of a Tai Po village house and purchases of tools days before the killing.

summary.en: A man has been arrested in Tai Po on suspicion of cruelty to animals after a mongrel was found hanged from a tree outside a stone house on Ma Wo Road. summary.en: The Housing Bureau announced today that the Public Housing Building Control Section has been formally established to replace the former Independent Checking Unit, strengthening regulation of existing buildings and maintenance and renovation works in all public rental housing estates and subsidised sale housing courts, as well as new public housing projects by the Housing Authority. The new section has two sub-sections covering new developments and existing building control, and will apply a new regulatory regime to large-scale maintenance projects in individual estates, co-ordinating supervision of the works in an integrated way. Project teams have been set up for the five housing courts and estates currently undergoing large-scale maintenance, with a liaison officer assigned to each, and the officers have already contacted the owners' corporations to explain the section's functions and the help available. The section will also continue improvement measures including targeted regulation of maintenance works, routine surprise inspections, closer monitoring of registered inspectors and contractors, and using technology to combat fraud.

summary.en: The Health Bureau announced today that free consultations by family doctors and Chinese medicine practitioners, free denture replacement services and the Hospital Authority's full medical fee waivers for residents affected by the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po, originally due to end this December, will be extended by four months to April 30 next year. Secretary for Health Professor Lo Chung-mau thanked Hospital Authority staff and private healthcare professionals, saying the public and private sectors have done their utmost to care for the injured and affected residents since the fire. As of October 30, hotlines at District Health Centres across the 18 districts had received 641 enquiries and handled 266 referrals, while the Hospital Authority has provided free medical services to about 2,500 affected residents, and all 79 patients admitted to public hospitals because of the fire have been discharged after recovery. Mental health support will also continue, including the 18111 Mental Health Support Hotline and the Hospital Authority's 24-hour Mental Health Direct hotline.

summary.en: The government announced today that the Environmental Impact Assessment report for the Lau Fau Shan, Tsim Bei Tsui and Pak Nai developments is available for public inspection under the Environmental Impact Assessment Ordinance from today until December 22. Lau Fau Shan is one of the nine New Development Areas in the Northern Metropolis, at its westernmost end, and the government proposes two thematic positionings for it: a Digital Technology Hub and leisure ecotourism, with about 30 hectares next to the future Lau Fau Shan Station earmarked for the hub to drive the digital economy through AI and blockchain. summary.en: The government's joint task force against bid-rigging in building maintenance works has carried out a second round of operations, smashing another syndicate involving 15 housing estates and residential buildings across Hong Kong, with works contracts totalling more than HK$130 million, and blocking two maintenance contracts worth about HK$7.6 million. Thirty-three people were arrested, including contractors, directors of works companies and owners' corporation members, some with triad backgrounds, on suspicion of forgery and conspiracy to defraud. Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the syndicate bought flats to infiltrate owners' corporations, bribed or intimidated professionals into becoming rubber stamps, and falsely claimed buildings had received mandatory inspection notices to rush owners into approving works and funding. summary.en: The Construction Innovation Expo 2026 is being held at the Convention and Exhibition Centre as a key event of the International Infrastructure Excellence Week, focusing on AI and smart construction, construction productivity and robotics, construction safety and sustainable construction, with more than 190 local, mainland and overseas exhibitors and an expected attendance of over 26,000. The Construction Industry Council is upgrading the construction workers registration system in phases, piloting facial recognition in place of card tapping at sites to simplify identity checks and improve site access management and safety monitoring. Exhibits also include drones that can inspect works safety and progress and even monitor the fire retardancy of scaffolding nets, as well as a walk-in spatial communications terminal from a mainland technology company that helps owners and contractors understand design and construction progress. Council executive director Thomas Ho said the expo, held once every three years, showcases the industry's newest, strongest and most exciting products and technologies.
summary.zh_hans: 建造创新博览会2026在会议展览中心举行，是国际基建卓越周的重要活动，聚焦人工智能及智能建造、建造生产力及机械人、建造安全、可持续建造四大关键领域，吸引逾190家本地、内地和海外参展商，预计逾26,000人次参与。建造业议会正分阶段提升建造业工人注册系统，推出先导计划，逐步在工地以人脸识别代替传统拍卡，简化身份核实和出入流程，同时加强工地安全监测。展览亦有无人机可探测工程安全及施工进度，甚至监察棚网阻燃性，以及内地科技公司设立的步入式空间通信终端，方便业主和承建商了解设计和施工进度。建造业议会执行总监郑定寕表示，创博会每三年举办一场，将行业最新、最强、最精彩的产品和技术向业界及公众展示。
summary.zh_hant: 建造創新博覽會2026在會議展覽中心舉行，是國際基建卓越周的重要活動，聚焦人工智能及智能建造、建造生產力及機械人、建造安全、可持續建造四大關鍵領域，吸引逾190家本地、內地和海外參展商，預計逾26,000人次參與。建造業議會正分階段提升建造業工人註冊系統，推出先導計劃，逐步在工地以人臉識別代替傳統拍卡，簡化身分核實和出入流程，同時加強工地安全監測。展覽亦有無人機可探測工程安全及施工進度，甚至監察棚網阻燃性，以及內地科技公司設立的步入式空間通信終端，方便業主和承建商了解設計和施工進度。建造業議會執行總監鄭定寕表示，創博會每三年舉辦一場，將行業最新、最強、最精彩的產品和技術向業界及公眾展示。

summary.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority announced today that the Faster Payment System will be unavailable from 1am to 11am on Sunday, November 29, for a planned system enhancement by its operator, Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited. The ten-hour suspension means the public will not be able to make FPS payments or transfers during that period. The authority has asked banks and stored value facility operators to notify customers in advance and in good time, and members of the public can contact individual banks or operators for details of the affected services and should make advance arrangements for their payment activities if necessary.
summary.zh_hans: 金管局今日宣布，转数快将于11月29日（星期日）凌晨1时至上午11时，因应系统提升暂停服务10小时，期间市民无法使用转数快付款及转账。系统提升由转数快营运机构香港银行同业结算有限公司进行。金管局已要求银行及储值支付工具营运商提前及适时通知客户，市民可向个别银行或营运商查询受影响服务详情，如有需要应预早安排付款活动。
summary.zh_hant: 金管局今日宣布，轉數快將於11月29日（星期日）凌晨1時至上午11時，因應系統提升暫停服務10小時，期間市民無法使用轉數快付款及轉賬。系統提升由轉數快營運機構香港銀行同業結算有限公司進行。金管局已要求銀行及儲值支付工具營運商提前及適時通知客戶，市民可向個別銀行或營運商查詢受影響服務詳情，如有需要應預早安排付款活動。
